title: PKG-L3-GBX-03 Predictive Maintenance Knowledge Base
equipment: Packaging line three gearbox drive station
authority: Demo maintenance engineering knowledge base; verify against released plant manual before dispatch.

sections.title: Gearbox vibration RMS escalation
sections.content: For PKG-L3-GBX-03, gearbox vibration RMS above 6.5 mm/s is treated as a high condition when paired with yellow PLC alarm GBX-VIB-HI. Recommended response is to avoid speed increase, inspect bearing condition, coupling alignment, gear mesh, mounting looseness, and lubrication state, then report to maintenance engineering.

sections.title: Gearbox and bearing temperature confirmation
sections.content: Gearbox housing temperature at or above 75 C, or bearing temperature at or above 70 C, requires manual-threshold comparison and near-term inspection when vibration is also elevated. Do not issue restart permission from temperature alone; compare against released threshold and trend.

sections.title: Lubrication record and oil smell cross-check
sections.content: If oil smell, oil staining, or delayed lubrication record appears with high vibration, inspect lubricant level, oil condition, gearbox seals, lubrication point GBX-03, and last service date. Treat operator sensory observations as evidence, but require maintenance confirmation before assigning final root cause.

sections.title: Operator sensory observation handling
sections.content: Low-frequency rumble, stronger guard vibration after speed increase, warm housing, and oil smell should be attached to the same maintenance session. These observations support maintenance_report escalation, but they do not prove bearing failure without manual, telemetry trend, or technician inspection evidence.
